args.message:
Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money, per FIN-212

The docstring already claimed ROUND_HALF_EVEN but the implementation
used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing nightly test failures in tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming otherwise.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money` so the implementation matches the documented behavior (per FIN-212).

## Testing
- CI run on this branch (commit 08d3cd5986) passes, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

Fixes the nightly build failure.
